capabilities: Manage knowledge projects with switchable Documents, Cards, and Whiteboards tabs, folders, and batch actions
Create standalone .sccard Markdown cards and import them as native Canvas nodes with mind-map layouts and nested child boards
Highlight text in Markdown files and PDFs with persistent, non-destructive highlights
Capture PDF text or rectangular regions into Canvas cards with backlinks to the exact region
Convert PDFs and images to Markdown through MinerU cloud parsing or a local compatible endpoint
disambiguation: Despite the manifest's 'flashcards, reviews' wording, the README describes knowledge cards and mind maps with no spaced-repetition review scheduling.
extras: Licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, so commercial use is prohibited; not yet marketplace-approved, so manual installation from GitHub releases is required; includes a full Chinese-language section; optional MinerU cloud OCR is subject to that provider's terms and pricing.
problem: Obsidian has no unified project view for managing cards, whiteboards, PDF reading/highlighting, and document OCR together in one place.
